overview: CharlieSierra Admin Console — a secure, multi-tenant government/military-grade admin panel for managing organizations, users, groups, audit logs, key escrow, and retention policies on the Internet Computer.
features: Protected admin route with role-based access control
Full user lifecycle management (invite, roles, suspend, remove)
Immutable audit log viewer with filters and CSV export
vetKeys-powered dual-control key escrow and recovery
Retention policy management with legal hold and compliance PDF export
Platform and organization settings with security controls
Government/military aesthetic with high-contrast professional design
